### Known deviations

- `discrete_hurdle_rows`: ECON-16, count-part SEs, NB hurdle theta (all hurdle estimates): not pinned to pscl::hurdle: the truncated-count information and the NB theta are Tier 4
- `discrete_negbin`: ECON-64, null log-likelihood and McFadden pseudo-R2: not pinned: the null log-likelihood omits the lnGamma terms and reuses the full model's theta (Tier 4)
- `driscoll_kraay`: REG-24, Driscoll-Kraay SEs, covariance, t and p: scores are averaged within period and the meat is multiplied by T: p2a 0.02186774128 / 0.04533713058 = sqrt(T)/N (0.4472135955) x vcovPL 0.04889775602 / 0.1013769059 (vcovpl_lag2 = vcovscc_lag2). The legacy reference vcovPL(cluster = ~time, order.by = ~time) aggregates by firm, not period (legacy_vcovpl_cluster_time), and is not a Driscoll-Kraay value
- `driscoll_kraay`: REG-50, non-Bartlett kernels: Parzen, Tukey-Hanning and QS use the j/m bandwidth convention while vcovPL uses bw = lag + 1; not pinned, and no case holds a vcovPL value for them, so there is no R or p2a value to record
- `gls`: REG-43, estimated rho ('ar1_auto') and the fit that uses it: the lag-1 correlation of the OLS residuals, 0.6541921822, not nlme's REML 0.6819761522 (phi) or ML 0.6532503857 (phi_ml)
- `gls`: REG-9, log-likelihood, AIC, BIC: omit -0.5 log\|Omega\| and use SSE/(n - p): at phi p2a gives -93.62614993, AIC 193.2522999, BIC 198.9883689 (post Tier 0) vs nlme REML logLik -79.12921201, AIC 166.2584240, BIC 173.7432281
- `hac`: REG-50, Quadratic Spectral SEs: the QS kernel is truncated at the bandwidth: p2a 0.2284575999 / 0.1414513262 vs kernHAC(kernel = 'Quadratic Spectral', bw = 4, prewhite = FALSE, adjust = FALSE) 0.2300539548 / 0.1392422079 (kernhac_qs_bw4)
- `hac`: REG-50, Bartlett bandwidth convention: p2a's Bartlett bandwidth m weights lag j by 1 - j/(m + 1), i.e. NeweyWest(lag = m) = kernHAC(bw = m + 1) (pinned); kernHAC(kernel = 'Bartlett', bw = 4) is 0.2102028704 / 0.1464461033 (kernhac_bartlett_bw4) where p2a's m = 4 gives 0.2204664393 / 0.1429954779. Parzen, Truncated and Tukey-Hanning use j/m and match kernHAC(bw = m)
- `hac`: REG-22, prewhitened SEs: prewhiten = true fits a scalar AR(1) to the residuals: p2a 0.2908704449 / 0.3059566437 vs NeweyWest(lag = 4, prewhite = TRUE) 0.2858936714 / 0.1360607244 (neweywest_lag4_prewhite)
- `hac`: REG-61, default bandwidth and small-sample adjustment: the default bandwidth is the fixed rule floor(4 (n/100)^(2/9)) = 4, not bwNeweyWest (2.513298742, bw_neweywest); there is no adjust = TRUE option: kernhac_*_bw4_adjust hold the adjusted values, e.g. Parzen 0.1977403619 / 0.1432982597 where p2a gives the unadjusted 0.1957529711 / 0.1418580397
- `ks_test_two_sample`: STAT-27, p-value (ks_p): p2a uses the asymptotic Kolmogorov distribution with Stephens' correction (0.19563779265722 on this case); R reports the exact p-value conditional on ties (0.15653867760174539). D is pinned.
- `line_missing`: REG-12, line coefficients (line_coef): R 0.441594195008563728 / 0.053890384144849528; p2a's resistant line is a different variant (-0.514777229630535849 / 0.062911296831234101 on the same 56 pairs by an R transcription of line.rs), Tier 4
- `mcp_descriptive_isoreg`: STAT-52, knot positions: p2a reports the first index of each block, R's iKnots the last; tied x are not pooled; only the number of knots is pinned
- `mcp_hypothesis_ks_test`: STAT-27, KS p-value: p2a is asymptotic with Stephens' correction (0.19563779265722031); R's exact p conditional on ties is 0.1565386776017454; not pinned
- `mcp_multivariate_mahalanobis_rows`: TOOL-10, chi_squared_threshold_95 and n_potential_outliers: the tool thresholds at 2.7 p instead of qchisq(0.95, p) (Tier 4); not pinned
- `mcp_stats_mauchly`: STAT-82, Mauchly p-value: p2a reports the first-order chi-square tail (pinned to R's own Pr1 = 5.0371160244126754e-05); R's mauchly.test adds Box's second-order term (5.450912248903203e-05); not pinned
- `mcp_stats_robust_and_interpolation`: STAT-36, IQR quantile types 2-6, 8, 9: silently computed as type 7; only the default type 7 is pinned
- `mcp_stats_robust_and_interpolation`: STAT-37, density curve: FFT grid mislabelled when n is not a power of two; density values not pinned
- `mcp_stats_robust_and_interpolation`: STAT-65, density bandwidth: default bandwidth is not bw.nrd0 and non-Gaussian kernels scale bw differently; not pinned
- `mcp_stats_robust_and_interpolation`: STAT-69, spline method fmm (the default): a clamped spline, not R's FMM; only method = natural is pinned
- `mcp_stats_robust_and_interpolation`: STAT-87, stats_fivenum iqr field: the hinge spread, not R's IQR; not pinned
- `mcp_stats_weighted`: TOOL-23, stats_cov_wt with center = false: the tool uses center to switch the correlation matrix and always centres the data (R cov.wt(center = FALSE) does not); pinned only with center omitted
- `medflex_na`: CAUS-23, NDE and NIE with interaction: NDE uses the raw control mean of M; Tier 4; not pinned
- `mediation_na`: CAUS-26, direct and indirect effects: NDE weight and labelling are Tier 4; not pinned
- `model_tables`: STAT-75, standard errors: p2a's model-tables SEs are SEs of individual means, R's model.tables SEs are for differences of means (and R refuses unbalanced designs); not compared until STAT-75 (Tier 4)
- `mood_test`: STAT-29, z and p with ties (mood_z, mood_p on xi/yi): R scores tied observations by Mielke's averaged positions; p2a squares the midrank deviation (z -2.6983447236552882 against R's -2.667468897704627). The tie-free pair mi/mj is pinned.
- `panel_missing_values`: ECON-34, mean-group SEs (mg_se): p2a reports the cross-entity standard deviation, not its standard error; only the mean-group coefficients are pinned (Tier 4)
- `quantreg`: REG-52, coefficients: IRLS with an absolute 1e-4 weight cap approximates the LP solution: relative differences from rq of 1.8e-5 / 5.5e-8 (tau 0.25), 2.8e-5 / 7.7e-6 (0.5), 1.0e-6 / 1.8e-6 (0.75) against the 1e-8 coefficient tolerance; tau 0.5 p2a 1.348696693 / 3.169975618 vs rq 1.348734984 / 3.169951199 (coef_tau50); the objective is within 2.3e-7 of rq's minimum
- `quantreg`: REG-26, standard errors, t, p: about sqrt(n) too small and an iid Silverman/Epanechnikov sparsity: tau 0.5 p2a 0.05028920546 / 0.008320075224 vs summary.rq iid 0.4807247768 / 0.07953329683, nid 0.1798711171 / 0.1079530876
- `quantreg`: REG-64, 95% confidence intervals: use 1.96 instead of a t quantile, around the REG-26 SEs: tau 0.5 slope p2a 3.153668270 to 3.186282965, i.e. estimate +/- 1.96 x 0.008320075224, where a t(98) interval on the same SE would use 1.984467455; no case holds an R interval (summary.rq's default rank-inversion intervals are not recorded)
- `rd_fuzzy`: CAUS-28, bandwidths when h and b are not given: p2a's own MSE-type selector, not rdbwselect; every case passes h and b
- `rd_multi`: CAUS-77, multi-cutoff pooling and heterogeneity test: not pinned to rdmulti::rdmc (Tier 3)
- `rd_sharp`: CAUS-28, bandwidths when h and b are not given: p2a's own MSE-type selector, not rdbwselect; every case passes h and b
- `regression_wrappers_columns`: REG-14, loess fitted values: not R-pinned (REG-14, REG-45: neighbourhood and span differ from R, Tier 4)
- `regression_wrappers_columns`: REG-26, quantreg SEs: not R-pinned (Tier 4)
- `resettest`: REG-35, type = 'princomp': not implemented: ResetType::PrinComp reuses the fitted-value augmentation; not exercised by any case. On Grunfeld (inv ~ value + capital, powers 2:3) p2a gives the fitted F 19.56011807 where resettest(type = 'princomp') gives 6.108133142 (df 2, 195)
- `staggered_did_cs`: CAUS-84, aggte type 'group' overall (selective_att, selective_se): recorded in the case, not reported by p2a: the headline overall ATT is the 'simple' aggregation (Tier 4)
- `supsmu_missing`: REG-31, smoothed values (supsmu_y): p2a's super smoother is not Friedman's algorithm (Tier 4); supsmu_y is recorded in the case, not compared
- `waldtest`: REG-37, Chisq statistic and p-value: p2a uses n (RSS_r - RSS_u) / RSS_u; lmtest::waldtest(test = 'Chisq') and aod::wald.test give q F = (n - k) (RSS_r - RSS_u) / RSS_u: diag_wald_sim drop x2 0.01248835701 vs 0.01198882273, drop x2 and x3 514.9909496 vs 494.3913116; Grunfeld drop capital 83.23811806 vs 81.98954629
- `weighting_na_refusal`: CAUS-92, effect and SE (IPW and the other estimators of this entry): only the missing-value refusals are pinned; no estimate is compared with R, and the R case for the IPW estimate comes with CAUS-92 (Tier 3)
- `wilcoxon`: STAT-72, rank-sum statistic: p2a's statistic is the rank sum R1 (pinned to ranksum_r1); R prints W = R1 - n_x (n_x + 1) / 2, compared as statistic - n (n + 1) / 2 until STAT-72 (Tier 4) changes the reported statistic
